sections.heading: TRAIL TO STREET, WITHOUT THE COSTUME.
sections.text: WHAT THIS ACTUALLY IS TRAIL TO STREET, WITHOUT THE COSTUME. SOFT FROM DAY ONE A combed cotton and polyester heather blend that already feels broken in. No stiff first wash, no cardboard phase. LIGHT, NOT SYNTHETIC 4.2 oz, so it breathes on warm days and dries quicker than pure cotton, without the clammy feel of a gym shirt. WHERE IT BELONGS Easy laps, dirt jumps, the van and the pint after. Fine for a short spin; a proper jersey still wins on a long, hot climb.

sections.heading: NOTHING EXISTS UNTIL YOU ORDER IT.
sections.text: HOW IT WORKS NOTHING EXISTS UNTIL YOU ORDER IT. YOU ORDER No stock, no warehouse, no pile of unsold shirts in the wrong sizes at the end of the season. Which is also why it never goes on sale. THE NEAREST PRESS MAKES IT Your order routes to the print house closest to your address, so the parcel crosses one border instead of three. IT SHIPS WITH TRACKING Two to four days on the press, two to five in transit. The tracking link reaches you the moment it exists.

sections.heading: KEEP IT. WE WILL SEND THE RIGHT ONE.
sections.text: WRONG SIZE KEEP IT. WE WILL SEND THE RIGHT ONE. Thirty days. The correct size goes on the press the same day, free. Do not post the first one back — it was made to order, so it cannot go to anyone else. Give it to someone it fits. If you would rather have the money back, you can have that instead.
